mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post(user_id, author, title, content_url, view_count, like_count, comment_count, create_time) VALUES(#{userId}, #{author}, #{title}, #{contentUrl}, #{viewCount}, #{likeCount}, #{commentCount}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET title = #{title}, content_url = #{content_url}, view_count = #{view_count}, like_count = #{like_count}, comment_count = #{comment_count} WHERE post_id = #{post_id}
mapper.select: SELECT p.* FROM post p WHERE p.user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM user_role WHERE role_code = 'OFFICIAL') ORDER BY p.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT p.* FROM post p ORDER BY (p.like_count + p.comment_count) DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.* FROM post p
AND p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY (p.like_count + p.comment_count) DESC
ORDER BY p.create_time DESC
LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post p
AND p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
